query:
SELECT se.id AS "id!"
FROM signal_events se
INNER JOIN organization_account_signal_links oasl
    ON oasl.signal_id = se.id
WHERE oasl.organization_id = $1
  AND oasl.account_id = $2
  AND se.status = 'ACTIVE'::signal_event_status
  AND se.source = $3
  AND se.event_type = $4::text::signal_event_type
